title: Governor Abiodun’s Christmas Carol Brings Top Gospel Voices to Abeokuta
excerpt: Ogun State’s 2026 Christmas Carol on Dec. 17 will feature Pastor Enoch Adeboye and leading gospel artists at Abeokuta’s Arcade Ground.
body:
The festive season is set to sparkle in Ogun State this year as the 2026 State Christmas Carol rolls out on Thursday, December 17. Organized by Governor Dapo Abiodun’s administration, the event promises an evening of worship, music and community spirit in Abeokuta.

## A Star‑Studded Lineup
Among the headline names is Pastor Enoch Adeboye, the General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG). Adeboye will join other top gospel artists, creating a powerful lineup that blends seasoned ministry with contemporary praise. The gathering aims to inspire attendees with uplifting messages and soulful melodies that capture the heart of the Christmas season.

## Where and When
The celebration will take place at the Arcade Ground in Oke‑Mosan, Abeokuta, kicking off at 5:00 p.m. The venue, known for hosting large public events, is expected to fill with families, worshippers and music lovers eager to share in the holiday cheer. According to Kayode Akinmade, Special Adviser to Governor Abiodun on Information and Strategy, the evening will feature “inspiring ministrations” and a vibrant program designed to lift spirits.

## A Community Celebration
Beyond the music, the Christmas Carol serves as a communal gathering, bringing together people from across the state to celebrate faith and togetherness. The event underscores Governor Abiodun’s commitment to cultural and religious festivities as a way to foster unity and joy during the holiday period.

The story was first reported by Premium Times Nigeria, highlighting the anticipation building around this festive showcase.
